name: Citadel
author: Neat Ouk
description: An outbound firewall in your bar. When an app connects somewhere new, it waits at the gate: see the app, who started it, its integrity, host, country and port, then Block, Allow once or Always allow. Policies per app, zones per network, threat feeds and AdGuard/Pi-hole imports, per-app proxy routing, live traffic and history. Watching works on its own; to block, install citadel-helper (github.com/NeatOuk/citadel-helper), a small root package that applies your policies with nftables.

barWidget.description: Watch outbound traffic and decide which apps may leave.

optional.networkmanager: zone switching by connection name (iwd and wired interfaces also work)
optional.citadel-helper: >= 1.1.1 to block; 1.3.2 (tag v1.3.2) for every feature: short connections, proxy routing, host names. https://github.com/NeatOuk/citadel-helper (build with makepkg -si)

groups.wheel: run the helper without a password prompt
